title: Sikkim High Court upholds suspension of judge accused of letting court clerk record evidence
description: The High Court of Sikkim recently refused to interfere with the suspension of a judge accused of abdicating her duties by letting her Peshkar (court clerk) record evidence while she stayed in her chambers.Chief Justice A Muhamed Mustaque observed that the allegations against the officer, if proven, would amount to serious misconduct warranting major penalty.The Court noted that more than ten individuals, including lawyers and court staff, had already given statements against the officer.“Suspens
